use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Random

let random = Random(50)
let colours = ["red", "yellow", "green", "blue"]
let names = ["you", "bot 1", "bot 2", "bot 3"]

use Card = (colour: string, value: string)

is_wild(card: Card) -> bool => card.colour =~ "wild"

name(card: Card) -> string =>
    if is_wild(card) then card.value else "{card.colour} {card.value}" fi

points(card: Card) -> int =>
    if is_wild(card) then 50
    elif card.value.length == 1 then int.parse(card.value)
    else 20
    fi

shuffled(cards: Iterable[Card]) -> LIST[Card] =>
    LIST[Card](
        cards
            |> map(c => (card = c, key = random.next()))
            |> sort((a, b) => a.key <> b.key)
            |> map(p => p.card))

new_deck() -> LIST[Card] is
    let deck = LIST[Card]()
    let values = ["skip", "reverse", "draw two"]

    for colour in colours do
        deck.add((colour, "0"))

        for value in (1::9) |> map(n => "{n}") |> cat(values) do
            deck.add((colour, value))
            deck.add((colour, value))
        od
    od

    for _ in 0..4 do
        deck.add(("wild", "wild"))
        deck.add(("wild", "wild draw four"))
    od

    shuffled(deck)
si

let hands = LIST[LIST[Card]]((0..4) |> map(_ => LIST[Card]()))
let scores = LIST[int]([0, 0, 0, 0])
let deck mut = LIST[Card]()
let discard = LIST[Card]()
let colour mut = ""
let direction mut = 1
let verbose mut = true

acts(seat: int, yours: string, theirs: string) -> string =>
    if seat == 0 then "you {yours}" else "{names[seat]} {theirs}" fi

say(text: string) is
    if verbose then
        write_line(text)
    fi
si

penalised(seat: int, cards: string) is
    let drawn = acts(seat, "draw {cards}", "draws {cards}")
    let missed = if seat == 0 then "miss" else "misses" fi
    say("  {drawn} and {missed} a turn")
si

draw(player: int, count: int) is
    for _ in 0..count do
        if deck.count == 0 then
            let top = discard[discard.count - 1]
            discard.remove_at(discard.count - 1)
            deck = shuffled(discard)
            discard.clear()
            discard.add(top)
            say("  the discard pile is shuffled to make a new deck")
        fi

        hands[player].add(deck[0])
        deck.remove_at(0)
    od
si

top() -> Card => discard[discard.count - 1]

matches(card: Card) -> bool =>
    is_wild(card) \/ card.colour =~ colour \/ card.value =~ top().value

has_colour(hand: List[Card]) -> bool =>
    hand |> any(c => c.colour =~ colour)

next_seat(seat: int) -> int => (seat + direction + 4) % 4

in_colour(hand: List[Card], wanted: string) -> int =>
    hand |> filter(card => card.colour =~ wanted) |> count()

favourite_colour(hand: List[Card]) -> string =>
    colours
        |> map(c => (colour = c, count = in_colour(hand, c)))
        |> sort((a, b) => b.count <> a.count)
        |> map(p => p.colour)
        |> first() ?? "red"

bot_choice(hand: List[Card]) -> int? =>
    (0..hand.count)
        |> filter(i => matches(hand[i]) /\ !is_wild(hand[i]))
        |> cat((0..hand.count) |> filter(i => hand[i].value =~ "wild"))
        |> cat((0..hand.count) |> filter(i =>
            hand[i].value =~ "wild draw four" /\ !has_colour(hand)))
        |> first()

let autopilot mut = false

ask(prompt: string) -> string? is
    if autopilot then
        return null
    fi

    write_line(prompt)
    let line = read_line()

    if !line? then
        autopilot = true
        write_line("(no more input, so your cards are played for you)")
        return null
    fi

    write_line("> {line}")
    line.trim().to_lower()
si

use Choice = (index: int, colour: string, uno: bool)

human_choice(hand: List[Card]) -> Choice? is
    write_line("your hand:")

    for row in 0..(hand.count + 3) / 4 do
        let cards =
            (row * 4..System.Math.min(row * 4 + 4, hand.count))
                |> map(i => "{i + 1}: {name(hand[i])}")
                |> join(", ")

        write_line("  {cards}")
    od

    while true do
        let answer = ask("your move?")

        if !answer? then
            return null
        fi

        if answer =~ "d" then
            return (index = -1, colour = "", uno = false)
        fi

        let words = answer.split([' '])
        let index mut = 0

        let valid =
            int.try_parse(words[0], index ref) /\
            index >= 1 /\ index <= hand.count

        if valid then
            let card = hand[index - 1]
            let chosen =
                words |> filter(w => colours |> any(c => c =~ w)) |> first()

            if !matches(card) then
                write_line("{name(card)} does not match")
            elif is_wild(card) /\ !chosen? then
                write_line("name a colour for the wild card")
            else
                return (
                    index = index - 1,
                    colour = chosen ?? card.colour,
                    uno = words |> any(w => w =~ "uno"))
            fi
        fi
    od

    null
si

automatic_choice(hand: List[Card]) -> Choice is
    if let index = bot_choice(hand) then
        let rest =
            (0..hand.count)
                |> filter(i => i != index)
                |> map(i => hand[i])
                |> collect_list()

        return (
            index = index,
            colour = favourite_colour(rest),
            uno = random.next(5) != 0)
    fi

    (index = -1, colour = "", uno = false)
si

use Played = (card: Card, bluffed: bool)

play(seat: int, choice: Choice) -> Played is
    let hand = hands[seat]
    let card = hand[choice.index]
    let bluffed = card.value =~ "wild draw four" /\ has_colour(hand)

    hand.remove_at(choice.index)
    discard.add(card)
    colour = if is_wild(card) then choice.colour else card.colour fi

    let calls = if seat == 0 then "call" else "calls" fi
    let called = if is_wild(card) then " and {calls} {colour}" else "" fi
    say("{acts(seat, "play", "plays")} {name(card)}{called}")

    if hand.count == 1 then
        if choice.uno then
            say("  {names[seat]}: uno!")
        else
            say("  {acts(seat, "don't", "doesn't")} call uno: two cards")
            draw(seat, 2)
        fi
    fi

    (card = card, bluffed = bluffed)
si

take_turn(seat: int) -> Played? is
    let hand = hands[seat]

    let choice =
        if seat == 0 /\ !autopilot then
            human_choice(hand) ?? automatic_choice(hand)
        else
            automatic_choice(hand)
        fi

    if choice.index >= 0 then
        return play(seat, choice)
    fi

    draw(seat, 1)
    let drawn = hand[hand.count - 1]
    say(
        if seat == 0 then "you draw {name(drawn)}"
        else "{names[seat]} draws a card"
        fi)

    let illegal = drawn.value =~ "wild draw four" /\ has_colour(hand)

    if !matches(drawn) \/ illegal then
        return null
    fi

    let chosen_colour mut = favourite_colour(hand)

    if seat == 0 /\ !autopilot then
        let answer = ask("play it? (y/n, with a colour if it is wild)")

        if let reply = answer then
            if !reply.starts_with("y") then
                return null
            fi

            chosen_colour =
                colours |> filter(c => reply.contains(c)) |> first() ??
                    chosen_colour
        fi
    fi

    let last = hand.count - 1
    play(seat, (index = last, colour = chosen_colour, uno = true))
si

challenges(seat: int) -> bool is
    if seat == 0 /\ !autopilot then
        let answer = ask("challenge the wild draw four? (y/n)")

        if answer? then
            return answer.starts_with("y")
        fi
    fi

    random.next(3) == 0
si

play_hand(dealer: int) -> int is
    deck = new_deck()
    discard.clear()
    direction = 1

    for hand in hands do
        hand.clear()
    od

    for seat in 0..4 do
        draw(seat, 7)
    od

    discard.add(deck[0])
    deck.remove_at(0)

    while top().value =~ "wild draw four" do
        deck.add(top())
        discard.clear()
        deck = shuffled(deck)
        discard.add(deck[0])
        deck.remove_at(0)
    od

    colour = top().colour
    say("{names[dealer]} dealt; the first discard is {name(top())}")

    let seat mut = next_seat(dealer)

    case top().value
    when "skip" then
        say("  {acts(seat, "miss", "misses")} a turn")
        seat = next_seat(seat)
    when "reverse" then
        direction = -1
        seat = dealer
    when "draw two" then
        penalised(seat, "two")
        draw(seat, 2)
        seat = next_seat(seat)
    when "wild" then
        colour = favourite_colour(hands[seat])
        say("  {acts(seat, "call", "calls")} {colour}")
    else
    esac

    while true do
        let player = seat
        let played = take_turn(player)

        if !played? then
            seat = next_seat(player)
            continue
        fi

        let victim = next_seat(player)

        case played.card.value
        when "skip" then
            say("  {acts(victim, "miss", "misses")} a turn")
            seat = victim
        when "reverse" then
            direction = -direction
        when "draw two" then
            penalised(victim, "two")
            draw(victim, 2)
            seat = victim
        when "wild draw four" then
            if hands[player].count > 0 /\ challenges(victim) then
                let challenger = acts(victim, "challenge", "challenges")

                if played.bluffed then
                    say("  {challenger}: the card was not allowed")
                    say("  {acts(player, "draw", "draws")} four instead")
                    draw(player, 4)
                else
                    say("  {challenger}: the card was allowed")
                    say("  {acts(victim, "draw", "draws")} six cards")
                    draw(victim, 6)
                    seat = victim
                fi
            else
                penalised(victim, "four")
                draw(victim, 4)
                seat = victim
            fi
        else
        esac

        if hands[player].count == 0 then
            return player
        fi

        seat = next_seat(seat)
    od

    -1
si

write_line("play a card by its number, naming a colour for a wild card")
write_line("and adding 'uno' as you go down to one card, or 'd' to draw:")
write_line("for example 3, 5 blue, or 2 uno")
write_line()

let dealer mut = 3
let hand_number mut = 0

while scores |> all(s => s < 500) do

    dealer = (dealer + 1) % 4

    let winner = play_hand(dealer)

    let won =
        (0..4)
            |> filter(s => s != winner)
            |> flat_map(s => hands[s])
            |> map(card => points(card))
            |> reduce(0, (a, b) => a + b)

    scores[winner] = scores[winner] + won
    verbose = false

    let standings =
        (0..4) |> map(s => "{names[s]} {scores[s]}") |> join(", ")

    write_line(
        "hand {hand_number}: {names[winner]} went out for {won} points; "
        "{standings}")
od

let champion = (0..4) |> filter(s => scores[s] >= 500) |> first() ?? 0
write_line("{acts(champion, "win", "wins")} the game")
